LESSON: KUANDIKA 6.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI INSHA YA MDOKEZO

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya mdokezo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya mdokezo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya insha ya mdokezo ili kuipambanua
2. kubainisha aina za insha ya mdokezo
3. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya mdokezo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya insha ya mdokezo ili kuipambanua
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya insha ya mdokezo ili kuipambanua. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kubainisha aina za insha ya mdokezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kubainisha aina za insha ya mdokezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya mdokezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili vipengele vya insha ya mdokezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya mdokezo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya mdokezo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya mdokezo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya mdokezo.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya insha ya mdokezo ili kuipambanua

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya mdokezo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Insha ya mdokezo important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya insha ya mdokezo ili kuipambanua
2. kubainisha aina za insha ya mdokezo
3. kujadili vipengele vya insha ya mdokezo

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
